title: North-campus garden and print frontage
caption: A planted harbour-side rest pocket and grounded print-shop service frontage finish this part of the existing campus loop. This is a bounded grounds pass; the far north and other unfinished island areas remain open work.

sections.title: Harbour garden and rest pocket
sections.caption: Joined low cover, shrub groups and grasses frame the existing paths, trees and bench. The open lawn and circulation remain.

sections.title: Print-shop frontage
sections.caption: A level side apron and fitted hardstanding support sheltered paper stock and a returns trolley. The shop interior and its printing service were completed separately.

sections.title: Map follows the ground
sections.caption: The map uses the same planting outlines, original nine tree positions, apron and service-pad footprints as the world.
